mo_ta_cong_viec:
We are looking for experienced software developers who are passionate about automotive innovation and eager to sharpen your expertise in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment.
The successful candidate will be responsible for the BSW development, maintenance, and SW verification to ensure the functionality and reliability of automotive BSW.
Responsibility
Configure and integrate AUTOSAR BSW modules such as: EcuM, Communication Stack (CanIf, CanTp, PduR, Com…), Memory Stack (NvM, Fee, Ea), Diagnostic Stack (DCM, DEM, FiM), System Services (BswM, WdgM, SchM, E2E, SecOC..).
Develop and maintain BSW related to C code and configuration files in compliance with AUTOSAR standards and automotive quality processes (A-SPICE), functional safety (ISO26262), cybersecurity (ISO21434).
Analyze system requirements and derive BSW configurations.
Integrate MCAL drivers and ensure proper interaction with BSW modules.
Perform unit testing, integration testing, debugging to find the root cause of issues and provide the resolutions.
Prepare technical documentation, design documents, and test reports. Manage software development workflows and ensure timely delivery of project milestones, while aligning with best practices in process driven engineering and collaborative development with Korean R&D Headquarter.
yeu_cau:
1+ years of experience in Embedded Software Development
Proficient in embedded C programming.
Solid understanding of AUTOSAR Classic Platform architecture.
Experienced with AUTOSAR BSW configuration and integration.
Experienced with automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, Ethernet).
Familiar with microcontrollers such as NXP, Infineon AURIX, or similar.
Experienced using debugging tools, oscilloscopes, CANoe, CANalyzer, and trace tools.
Understanding of software development lifecycle and version control systems (Git, SVN,..).
Self-driven and capable of working independently.
Good in English communication and teamwork skills, especially in fast-paced environments.
